title: Direct ERC20 donation to the contract inflates totalDebt view and becomes stranded or claimed asymmetrically
description: Anyone can `rewardToken.transfer(address(NFTStaker), X)` without going through `topUp`. The donation is NOT added to `rewardBudget`, so it does not affect `rewardRate` or `windowEnd` — but it IS visible to `_safePay` (which checks raw `balanceOf`) and to the `totalDebt` view (which computes `balance - budget`). Consequences: (1) `totalDebt()` over-reports because it treats donated funds as already-accrued user debt. (2) `_safePay` will happily transfer donated funds if a user's `pending` exceeds `rewardBudget` plus settlement (e.g. due to truncation dust accumulating or a mis-accounted state). (3) The donated funds are stranded in the contract after window end unless owner reconfigures via `setWindowDuration` (which at least pulls them into the next rate calc — but `setWindowDuration` itself has the mintDebt exclusion issue from ES-04).
economicImpact: Low. Donations can silently inflate the view-layer's `totalDebt` output by their full magnitude, which off-chain dashboards may interpret as stakers having more claimable reward than they do. `_safePay` uses donations as a buffer for rounding-up edge cases, which preserves payment safety but also means a malicious donor could inject a known amount to bait off-chain monitors that alert on `totalDebt` spikes.
attackPath:
1. Adversary transfers Y phUSD directly to the NFTStaker contract.
2. `totalDebt()` immediately reports `+Y` additional debt.
3. Off-chain monitors / UIs that display 'unpaid rewards' mis-report by Y.
4. Eventually, if the schedule expires and Y remains, it is owner-rescue-able only via `setWindowDuration` / implicit use as a shortfall-pay buffer.
quantifiedLoss: No direct loss to stakers; view-layer inaccuracy and minor ops-confusion risk. Donated funds are non-refundable to the donor (no exit path).
recommendation: Consider tracking accounted balance explicitly and using it (rather than `balanceOf(this)`) in both `_safePay` and `totalDebt`. A `donate()` entry point that adds the transferred amount to `rewardBudget` and logs an event would give donors a predictable, accounted path. At minimum document in `totalDebt`'s NatSpec that the returned value includes any raw donated balance.
